documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
Disclosures under Reg. 29(1) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011

analysis.summary: Bajaj Auto Limited reported record-breaking financial performance for Q1 FY27 across all parameters despite facing commodity inflation, supply chain disruptions, and a ransomware attack. Volumes reached 1.4 million units, revenue crossed INR17,000 crores, and EBITDA margins stood at 20.9%. Management highlighted strong growth in exports and electric vehicles, alongside plans for capacity expansion by approximately 25% from 7 million to 9 million units per annum. The company also announced an upcoming total portfolio makeover for domestic motorcycles, aiming to introduce multiple new models and variants within the next 6 weeks. Bajaj Auto management reported a record-breaking performance for FY26, with consolidated revenues crossing INR63,000 crores and consolidated profit after tax exceeding INR10,000 crores.

guidance.claim: Management estimates the near-term motorcycle category growth to slow down to 7% to 9%.
guidance.quote: This is bound to slow down the motorcycle category from its rocking 20% growth in Q4 to we estimate 7% to 9% in the near term.

guidance.claim: Management expects the motorcycle industry to continue to grow at 12% to 15%.
guidance.quote: We expect this growth momentum in the industry to continue and the motorcycle industry to continue to grow at, say, 12% to 15%.

guidance.claim: The export business is on track to deliver its highest-ever top-line performance in USD terms this financial year.
guidance.quote: In fact, the business is on the path to deliver its highest ever top line performance in USD terms this financial year.

guidance.claim: Management expects the export growth tempo to continue in the coming months.
guidance.quote: Overall, the Exports business has established a sustained growth momentum, and we expect this growth tempo to continue in the coming months.

guidance.claim: Management expects to grow their leadership position quite decisively in the coming quarters in the e-auto segment.
guidance.quote: We expect to grow our leadership position quite decisively in the coming quarters.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the demand environment across both domestic and international key markets is very positive.
demand_outlook.quote: Having said that, the demand environment, both in domestic and international, particularly in our key markets, is very positive, though the business environment may still be a bit volatile.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand environment softened in April due to general inflation, increased vehicle prices, LPG shortages, and manpower migration.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand environment, it has softened in April due to general inflation, increased prices of our vehicles, LPG shortages, manpower migration and the LPG shortage-led effect on the consumer sentiment.

demand_outlook.claim: The top 30 overseas markets grew by about 10% in the quarter, with Bajaj Auto sales growing at 15%.
demand_outlook.quote: The top 30 overseas markets collectively accounting for nearly 75% of the emerging market, industry grew by about 10% in this quarter with our sales growing at 15%, thereby signalling an increase of market share in these key markets.

demand_outlook.claim: The ICE segment in commercial vehicles grew at 4% to 5% following GST cuts.
demand_outlook.quote: The ICE segment was declining in April-August period by about 4%, but GST cuts have bumped up growth to positive 4% to 5%.

demand_outlook.claim: The electric segment continues to drive the 3-wheeler industry by growing at about 50% plus.
demand_outlook.quote: The Electric segment continues to drive the 3-wheeler industry by growing at about 50% plus.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is undertaking a capacity expansion of nearly 25% from the current 7 million units per annum to progressively go up to 9 million units per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: So, with an eye on the future, we are undertaking an expansion of capacity by almost 25% from the current 7 million units per annum across different businesses to progressively go up to 9 million units per annum.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex for the year was approximately INR500 crores, split equally between ICE and EV investments.
capex_expansion.quote: Capex for the year was approximately INR500 crores, split equally between ICE and EV investments.

capex_expansion.claim: Joint KTM-Triumph showrooms are planned to expand from about 50 operational outlets to over 100 by March.
capex_expansion.quote: We currently have about 50 KT showrooms operational and plan to expand these to over 100 by March.

margins_costs.claim: Commodity inflation intensified during the quarter, taking the overall impact to about 4.5% of revenue.
margins_costs.quote: Inflation across the metals complex accelerated meaningfully through May, taking the overall inflationary impact for the quarter to about 4.5% of revenue.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for the quarter reached 20.9%, an improvement of 10 basis points sequentially.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins inched up to 20.9%, an improvement of 10 basis points sequentially despite the hyperinflationary commodity environment that I'd spoken about.

margins_costs.claim: Quarter 4 EBITDA margins held steady at 20.8%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA came in at INR3,323 crores and the margins at 20.8% sustained despite challenges in the operating environment.

margins_costs.claim: Management estimates material cost inflation of approximately 3.5% to 4% of revenue.
margins_costs.quote: Taken together, we are currently estimating a material cost inflation impact of approximately 3.5% to 4% of revenue.

margins_costs.claim: The electric business now delivers double-digit EBITDA margin while improving unit economics.
margins_costs.quote: More importantly, the EV business now delivers double-digit EBITDA margin while improving unit economics as the portfolio continues to scale.

margins_costs.claim: Average dollar realization for the quarter stood at 88.3 compared to 87.1 in quarter 2 and 84.3 a year ago.
margins_costs.quote: Currency remained a tailwind during this quarter, and I've spoken about this the last time we have met, with average dollar realization for the quarter standing at 88.3, compared to 87.1 in quarter 2 and 84.3 a year ago.

margins_costs.claim: The net price versus cost inflation hit was nearly 50 basis points on the margin due to deferred pricing actions.
margins_costs.quote: As a result, we saw a net price versus cost inflation hit of nearly 50 basis points on the margin.

margins_costs.claim: A onetime exceptional charge of INR 61 crores was recognized towards past service cost arising from changes under the new labour code.
margins_costs.quote: As you're all aware, pursuant to the amendment in the definition of wages under the new labour code, we recognized INR61 crores as a onetime exceptional charge towards the past service cost arising from the changes introduced under the new labour code.

orders_capacity.claim: Chetak manufacturing capacity has now reached 50,000 units per month.
orders_capacity.quote: And we have now a capacity of 50,000 units per month.

orders_capacity.claim: Exports crossed the 600,000 units mark after 15 quarters.
orders_capacity.quote: The BU crossed the 200,000 average per month sales level in October '25 after nearly 40 months and maintained this level through the remainder of the quarter, surpassing the 600,000 units mark after 15 quarters.

orders_capacity.claim: The Pro-Biking business delivered a combined volume of over 35,000 units, registering growth of around 50% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: The 2 brands together delivered a record domestic performance with combined volumes of over 35,000 units, registering robust growth of around 50% year-on-year and marking the highest-ever quarterly performance for the business, lifted also by the positive sentiment.

orders_capacity.claim: Bajaj Auto maintains a 70% plus market share in the ICE segment with an 85% plus share in the CNG segment.
orders_capacity.quote: We continue to maintain a 70% plus market share in the ICE segment with an overwhelming share of 85% plus in the CNG segment, which is the largest segment within ICE.

capital_allocation.claim: Surplus cash stood in excess of INR21,000 crores at the end of the June quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: The balance sheet continues to remain very healthy with surplus cash in excess of INR21,000 crores at the end of the June quarter, well managed and providing sufficient fuel for future growth investments, strategic opportunities and improved shareholder returns.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board approved a payout of 100% of profits made last year via a final dividend and a tender-route buyback.
capital_allocation.quote: Lastly, the Board of Directors at its meeting earlier today approved a payout of 100% of the profits that we have made last year in recognition of the 100 years milestone of the Bajaj family in India and with Bajaj Auto being the flagship company that started it all. his will be split as follows a final dividend of INR150 per share that will aggregate to INR4,192 crores and the balance of about INR5,633 crores will be towards a buyback under the tender route at a buyback price of INR12,000 per share.

capital_allocation.claim: Surplus cash closed at about INR 15,000 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We continue to deliver strong and consistent cash generation, closing the quarter with surplus cash of about INR15,000 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: In the first 9 months of the year, the company generated nearly INR 5,200 crores of free cash flow, up 70% over the same period last year.
capital_allocation.quote: It's also worth noting that in the first 9 months of this year, we've generated nearly INR5,200 crores of free cash flow, and that was up 70% over the same period last year, reflecting our strong track record of converting profit to cash.

capital_allocation.claim: The last infusion done into BACL was in October of about INR 300 crores as Tier 2 capital.
capital_allocation.quote: The last infusion we did into BACL was in October of about INR300 crores. And that we think is absolutely the last of it that is needed. In fact, that infusion also went in as Tier 2 capital.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that supply chain disruptions, logistics issues, and a ransomware attack impaired availabilities by about 10% to 15%.
risks_headwinds.quote: All of these above issues combined impaired availabilities by about 10% to 15%, more so in exports, high-end bikes and EVs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Supply chain difficulties in terms of LPG shortages, manpower availability, and outbound logistics have impaired availability to service demand by about 10% to 15%.
risks_headwinds.quote: Supply chain difficulties in terms of the LPG shortage, manpower availability and outbound logistics to overseas markets have impaired availability to service demand by about 10% to 15%.

risks_headwinds.claim: Noble metals including platinum, palladium, and rhodium saw sharp increases, while aluminium, copper, nickel, and lead also continued to harden.
risks_headwinds.quote: Noble Metals especially platinum, palladium and rhodium all saw sharp increases, whilst aluminium, copper, nickel and lead also continued to harden.

risks_headwinds.claim: The withdrawal of PM E-DRIVE incentives resulted in an impact of approximately INR 23,000 to INR 25,000 per vehicle in the electric 3-wheeler segment.
risks_headwinds.quote: While the withdrawal occurred towards the later part of the quarter, the impact was meaningful at approximately INR23,000 to INR25,000 per vehicle, and we consciously chose to hold pricing and absorb this impact in order to invest behind growth and accelerate volumes and our competitive position in this segment.

risks_headwinds.claim: GST rates on motorcycles exceeding 350cc increased from 31% to 40%.
risks_headwinds.quote: You recall when we had last spoken, the GST rates on motorcycles in excess of 350cc had moved up from the 31%, which was essentially 28% GST rate plus 3% cess to 40%.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to accomplish an exhaustive portfolio makeover for domestic motorcycles within the next 6 weeks.
management_commitments.quote: Our aim is to accomplish this exhaustive portfolio makeover within the next 6 weeks.

management_commitments.claim: Management intends to move BMAG and KTM AG to quarterly reporting as a voluntary action to align with Bajaj Auto's reporting calendar.
management_commitments.quote: Going forward, it is our intention to move BMAG, KTM AG to quarterly reporting as a voluntary action to align with Bajaj Auto's reporting calendar and as a measure of good governance and transparency.

management_commitments.claim: Over 8 more interventions in the Pulsar portfolio will be made in the next 4 months.
management_commitments.quote: The waves of these interventions will be unrelenting here onwards with over 8 more such interventions being made in the next 4 months.

management_commitments.claim: The top management team build for KTM Austria will be completed by 1st April.
management_commitments.quote: The top deck is now largely in place, and the exercise will be completed by 1st April.

management_commitments.claim: KTM showrooms will be expanded to over 100 by March.
management_commitments.quote: We currently have about 50 KT showrooms operational and plan to expand these to over 100 by March.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
